actions.objective: Download the referenced YouTube video, extract the full ordered list of player inputs/moves from the video, and write them one per line to /app/solution.txt.
required_artifacts: downloaded local copy of the referenced video or equivalent inspectable media artifact
required_behaviors: Acquire the referenced video content from the provided URL.
Determine the complete ordered sequence of moves entered by the player from the video content.
Write exactly one move per line into /app/solution.txt using the move text as shown/derived from the video.
known_invalid_patterns: Guessing or inventing moves without evidence from the video.
Treating file existence or non-empty output as sufficient without verifying the move sequence.
Using partial transcript or partial move list as completion.
verification_plan: Download or otherwise obtain an inspectable local copy of the referenced video.
Extract the move sequence from the video content with evidence.
Write /app/solution.txt and verify its contents against the extracted sequence.
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the downloaded/inspectable video artifact.
Receipt-backed evidence of the extracted complete move list.
Receipt-backed evidence that /app/solution.txt contains the same complete move list, one per line.
notes: Need to preserve the original request even if environment/tooling is sparse.

plan.current_focus: Inspect workspace and tool availability, then obtain the referenced video for transcription.
evidence_gaps: No transcript or move evidence yet
next_steps: Acquire the video or determine an alternate visible route to inspect its contents
plan.objective: Produce /app/solution.txt with the full ordered move list from the referenced Zork gameplay video after downloading and transcribing the video.

items: Extract the full ordered move list
Write /app/solution.txt with one move per line
